input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-and-exclusive-provider commitment in Section 2.2, as our playbook does not permit exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations on the Customer, and this clause conflicts with Sections 2.1 and 12.3 (no purchase commitment; no exclusivity commitment). If Silverline needs some protection, we could consider exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
input.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity obligation binding Customer.
